Sacred Scars - March 14, 2006

-----
Made for: Winamp Forums Compilation Four

-----
Always searching for that perfect combination of effects, I think I have managed to capture a real beauty. I'm very proud of this preset, though it took me roughly seven weeks to get just right.

At some point during the creation of this preset, it occured to me that the DM is very similar to one of my contributions to WFC3: The Convicts. Sure enough, the coding is almost the same. There's a few small difference, but what a coincidence it is.

Much thanks to Yathosho for the inspirational direction in his review on my last pack, Reincarnation. Thanks also to Jheriko for helping me learn how to incorporate fps independancy. Did I get it right, yet? I'm trying....

I apologize that this starts up in a very poor way. If you're viewing this pack from beginning to end, you may have to press "y" and then "u" again to get it to work properly.

-----
Optimization(s):
------------------------
I apologize for the speed problems. This runs at 51.2 fps for me, however I'm well aware of problems that occur with older and slower computers. Because of this, here is a small list of options that you can choose from to increase the speed, but lower the quality:

- Disable the fourth effect list. This effect lists contains the video delay. It will increase your fps by 10 to 15%.
- Disable the third to last effect list. This effect list contains two other effect lists. This will disable the rotating background and increase   your fps by 15 to 20%.

Disabling both of these effects lists should increase your fps anywhere from 30 to 40%. However as aforementioned, the quality will be decreased a bit.

-----
Musical Influnence(s):
----------------------------------
- The Crystal Method: Keep Hope Alive
- Massive Attack: Black Milk
- Tool: Lateralus

-----
Enjoy!

Spiral out, my friend. You will find your way back to yourself, we all will. I'll be waiting, and shall see you on the other side...
